name: Quality Assurance
excerpt: Quality Assurance involves activities to satisfy quality standards.
notes: Quality Assurance in project management includes all activities relevant to satisfying quality standards. It involves benchmarking, quality audits, and using tools like cause and effect diagrams.
context_summary:
- Involves activities to satisfy quality standards.
- Includes benchmarking and quality audits.
- Uses tools like cause and effect diagrams.
